parts.text: Remove the second floating pig mask to the right of his head completely and fill that area with the misty lake and pine trees backdrop. He keeps wearing the one pig mask on his face. Give the whole figure a hand-pressed plasticine finish: chunky simplified forms, visible fingerprint and tool marks on the clay, flat matte colours, no realistic skin texture. Keep everything else identical (chainsaw, denim jacket, tool belt, backpack, pose, cabin backdrop). No text.
